## Intent

The doc comment of `getProfileData` in `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` still ends with "TODO: Add
organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". The TODO is stale and misleading:
workspaces have existed for months, the profile page is personal-only by decision (the `profile-personal-only`
increment), `getProfileData` reads only one person's `user` and `user_profiles` rows, and `CLAUDE.md` says nothing about
it. A reader following it would add a workspace parameter the design deliberately does not have. The owner wants the
TODO replaced by one doc-comment sentence stating the actual rule: the profile is per person, not per workspace, so
`getProfileData` takes no organization id.

Separately, `main` fails the formatting gate (`npm run format:check`) on exactly one file,
`docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`, merged unformatted in #384. The owner wants Prettier run on that one file so the
gate is green again, changing its formatting only, never its wording.

## Scope

**In scope:**

- Replace the stale TODO in `getProfileData`'s doc comment with one sentence: the profile is per person, not per
  workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
- Format `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` with the project's Prettier configuration.

**Out of scope (non-goals):**

- Any behaviour change to `getProfileData`: its signature, its return value and its E2E fixture branch stay exactly as
  they are.
- Changing the existing profile tests.
- Changing the wording of `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`, or formatting any other file.
- Adding workspace awareness to the profile, or editing `CLAUDE.md` or any other doc.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1** Given the files under `features/profile/` When their contents are searched for the text
  "multi-workspace support" and for a TODO mentioning an organizationId parameter Then neither search returns a match
  - verify: unit
- **AC-2** Given `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` When the doc comment directly above
  `export async function getProfileData` is read Then it contains the phrase "per person" and the phrase
  "organization id", and contains no "TODO"
  - verify: unit
- **AC-3** Given the repository after the change When `npx prettier --check docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` runs
  Then it exits with status 0
  - verify: integration

## Constraints

- No behaviour change: `getProfileData(userId: string): Promise<ProfileData>` keeps its signature, return value and E2E
  fixture branch; the existing profile tests stay untouched and must still pass.
- The change to `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` is whitespace and formatting only, exactly what Prettier produces
  with the project's configuration; its words are unchanged.
- The rest of the existing doc comment above `getProfileData` (what it reads and its defaults) stays.

## Assumptions

- AC-2's two phrases ("per person", "organization id") are the observable form of "states that the profile is per
  person and takes no organization id"; the sentence may word the rest freely.
- Read this run: `npm run format:check` reports only `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`, and Prettier's change to it
  is a single inserted blank line, so formatting that file makes the repository-wide gate green as well.
- Read this run: the TODO is the only "TODO" under `features/profile/`, so AC-1 is satisfied by replacing that one line.
- The project's `test` script is `vitest run`, so the criteria have a runner; AC-3 is checked by running Prettier as a
  subprocess.

## Intent

The doc comment of `getProfileData` in `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` still ends with "TODO: Add
organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". That TODO is stale and misleading:
workspaces have existed for months, the profile page is personal-only by decision (`pharn/features/profile-personal-only`),
`getProfileData` reads only one person's `user` and `user_profiles` rows, and `CLAUDE.md` says nothing about adding such
a parameter. A reader of the service today is told to plan a change that will never happen. The owner wants the TODO
replaced with one sentence stating the actual rule: the profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData`
takes no organization id.

Separately, `main` currently fails `npm run format:check` because `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` was merged
unformatted (#384). The owner wants that one file run through Prettier so the formatting gate is green again, with only
its formatting changed and none of its wording.

  not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
- Formatting `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` with the project's Prettier so that it passes `prettier --check`.
